TestTruncate::test_truncate_after_restar.description: Starts 1 node, creates ks.test1 (RF=1), bootstraps node2, writes 30 rows and reads them back. Restarts node2, then via 3 exclusive connections to node2 ("to exercise many shards") re-inserts data, TRUNCATEs and asserts the table is empty at CL=ALL. Regression for scylladb/scylladb#3798: after restart, non-zero shards kept stale gossiper STATUS (shutdown) for the restarted node, so TRUNCATE coordinated on a non-zero shard skipped the node and data survived.

origin.summary: Tomasz Grabiec: 'cql_tests: Introduce test for truncate after restart', reproduces scylladb#3798 (fixed by scylla c4ec81e126 'gms/gossiper: Always override states from older generations').

TestTruncate::test_truncate_after_restar.relevance: Live. Vnode-keyspace TRUNCATE still goes through storage_proxy::remote::send_truncate_blocking (service/storage_proxy.cc:490), which uses gossiper liveness (is_alive / get_live_token_owners), so per-shard gossiper state after restart still matters. Gossiper replication was rewritten (gossiper::replicate, gms/gossiper.cc:1431) so the exact #3798 code path is gone. In the next-dtest-tablets job the keyspace uses tablets and TRUNCATE goes via the topology coordinator (truncate_with_tablets), so the original scenario is only exercised in the vnodes (consistent-topology) job. Cheap: ~12s, 100% pass (32 runs).

TestTruncate::test_truncate_after_restar.reason: Unique-ish regression for scylladb#3798 (truncate coordinated by a restarted node on non-zero shards, vnodes path still gossiper-based); no scylla test covers post-restart vnode truncate. Downgraded from GREEN for issues. Note: 'many connections to exercise many shards' (cql_tests.py:~716) does not guarantee different coordinator shards with the shard-aware driver, so the #3798 trigger is probabilistic. Note: in the tablets job truncate takes the topology-coordinator path, so the guarded gossiper path is not exercised there. Note: refs closed issue #3798 (fixed 2018, scylla c4ec81e126).

issues.text: 3 connections don't guarantee non-zero coordinator shard with shard-aware driver; #3798 trigger probabilistic.
In tablets job truncate takes topology-coordinator path; guarded gossiper path only exercised in vnodes job.
